title: A Saturday Without a Car
transcript: When my car went into the garage, I had to find another way to visit my parents. I took the train to their town and walked the last twenty minutes. On the way, I noticed an outdoor market that I had never seen from the main road. I bought a bag of local apples there and arrived before lunch. My car was ready by Monday, but I decided to take the train whenever I could. The walk was the part I enjoyed most.

questions.prompt: Why did the speaker change the way of travelling?
options: The parents moved to another town.
questions.explanation: car went into the garage 表示车送去修理了。

questions.prompt: Why did the speaker choose to travel this way again?
options: The train stopped closer to the house.
questions.explanation: 结尾指出步行是说话者最喜欢的一段。
